svg.text: Layout A: tap a line, comment in a sheet, finish from the PR
Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915. Synthetic sample: acme-co/orders-api #365, a migration diff, riley-k's question, one bot finding.
Composer is a bottom sheet with Add to review and Comment (like GitHub). Drafts collect in a pending bar on the PR sheet. Since my review is a toggle on the Files tab.
Tap a line number to select it. Tap a second line to extend the range.
Add to review saves a draft. Comment posts now.
Use if_exists on the index too?
Draft shows under its line. The diff bar counts drafts.
Use if_exists on the index too?
Diff header ... menu: Comment on file. Same sheet.
PR sheet: bar above Approve/Comment while drafts exist.
Pick an event, optional summary. Request changes needs a summary.
Looks good once the index is guarded.
Files tab: segmented toggle. Only files changed since your review.
Existing threads show as a pill under their line; tap opens them.
A9 Reply on a human thread
Thread tab: every thread gets Reply, not only bot findings.
Can we rename the migration class too?
The diff adds the new migration without ...
Text stays. Retry posts again; nothing is lost.
